title: Enterprise aggregated report bundles + priority routing for scheduled exports
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Introduce an enterprise-grade scheduled export feature that bundles tenant-aware aggregated usage and cost dashboards into encrypted delivery artifacts (snapshot + incremental modes). Provide console-level request routing so enterprise customers can opt into priority lanes with SLA windows (daily/weekly) and choose delivery patterns (SFTP, customer cloud bucket, API webhook).
background: We get frequent enterprise asks for scheduled, automated exports of multi-tenant usage and cost breakdowns with strict delivery windows and audit controls. Current ad-hoc CSV exports via the console are insufficient: customers need tenant-aware rollups, PII redaction, encrypted bundles, and guaranteed delivery SLAs. Several enterprise deals are pending acceptance criteria around scheduled reporting and delivery SLAs.
goals: Design console UX to let workspace admins configure scheduled export bundles (frequency, tenant scope, redaction rules)
Implement backend pipeline to produce encrypted snapshot and incremental bundles with per-tenant rollups and cost breakdowns
Add delivery adapters: SFTP, AWS/GCP/Azure customer buckets, webhook with retries and delivery receipts
Expose SLA/prioritization choice in console and route delivery requests through priority queues
Ensure export artifacts are auditable and logged for compliance (checksum, delivery receipts, KMS-wrapped keys)
scope_in: Console: scheduled export UI, permissioning, and routing selection
Service: export generation (snapshot + incremental), tenant rollups, PII redaction presets
Delivery: SFTP + customer cloud bucket adapters, webhook with retry and backoff
Observability: per-export status, delivery receipts, cost estimate for export generation
scope_out: Custom per-customer ETL beyond rollups (we provide CSV/Parquet artifacts only)
On-prem appliance delivery (requires Private deployment separate project)
proposed_solution: Build a scheduled export pipeline that reads tenant usage telemetry, applies configurable rollup and redaction rules, and writes time-windowed artifacts to a staging bucket. Artifacts are encrypted with per-customer KMS keys, signed, and pushed to the chosen delivery adapter. A priority routing layer will tag urgent exports and assign them to a high-throughput generation queue with tighter SLAs. Console changes include a guided workflow to define scope, redaction, delivery method, and SLA lane. Admins can preview a sample bundle and run on-demand export before enabling schedule.
acceptance_criteria: Console allows creation of scheduled export with frequency (daily/weekly/monthly), tenant selection, and delivery method
Export pipeline produces encrypted artifacts (Parquet and CSV) with per-tenant cost breakdown columns and an accompanying manifest (checksum, row counts)
Delivery adapters succeed in test pushes to SFTP and customer S3/GCS/Azure buckets with retries and receipts logged
Priority lane exports show measurable reduced median generation latency under load (target: 50% lower vs standard lane)
Audit logs record export creation, delivery attempts, and successful receipts; logs are queryable from Console
Security review sign-off completed for redaction presets, KMS key usage, and delivery adapters
risks: High CPU/GPU cost for generating large snapshot bundles on short windows -> may increase infra spend
Delivery failures to customer endpoints require clear backoff & escalation (legal/regulatory risk for missed SLAs)
Redaction edge cases may leak PII if new telemetry fields are added without mapping
KMS key management complexity across dedicated/private customers
rollout_plan: MVP behind feature flag for pilot customers (2-3 enterprise accounts)
Pilot run for 6 weeks with daily progress and infra cost tracking
Iterate UX and add audit/export receipt improvements based on pilot feedback
Gradual enablement: opt-in on the Console and add SLA billing metrics to billing pipeline
Full GA after security sign-off and two successful pilot cycles
metrics: % of enterprise scheduled exports delivered within SLA (target >= 98%)
Median artifact generation latency - standard vs priority lane (target: priority lane 50% faster)
Number of delivery failures per 1000 exports
Infra cost per GB of generated artifact (track trend)
Pilot customer satisfaction NPS / qualitative feedback
timeline: Design + spec: 2 weeks; Engineering MVP: 4 weeks; Pilot: 6 weeks; Iteration + GA prep: 3 weeks
notes: We should coordinate with Billing to surface export-related charges and priority-lane billing metrics
Consider offering encrypted bundle checksum and signed manifests to satisfy SOC2/ISO auditors
Talk to Solutions Eng for templated redaction presets used by regulated industries (finance, healthcare)
